name: Server Mode — Remote Access for Omarchy
author: 0x1ocean
description: Keep an Omarchy laptop or desktop reachable for remote work: prevent sleep or lid-close suspend, set timed sessions and battery safeguards, and monitor LAN, Tailscale, SSH, Sunshine, RustDesk, and WayVNC readiness from the bar.

barWidget.description: Keep this computer awake for remote work and check LAN, Tailscale, SSH, and remote desktop readiness.

schema.label: Default protection
schema.description: Full server blocks every suspend request. Lid only blocks suspend caused by closing a laptop lid.

schema.label: Default duration (minutes)
schema.description: Use 0 to keep Server Mode active until logout or until you turn it off.

schema.label: Start on login
schema.description: Enable Server Mode when the Omarchy shell starts.

schema.label: Start when plugged in
schema.description: Enable Server Mode when a laptop switches from battery to external power.

schema.label: Stop when unplugged
schema.description: Restore normal sleep as soon as a laptop starts using its battery.

schema.label: Low-battery cutoff (%)
schema.description: Stop Server Mode at this charge while on battery. Use 0 to disable the cutoff.

schema.label: Notifications
schema.description: Show a notification when Server Mode changes state.
